cohort.patient_grouping: not exposed by the public acquisition view; no patient-level claim
cohort.raw_data_policy: the checksum-verified source Parquet and each decoded image exist only in a temporary directory during inference and are deleted on exit; aggregate results only are written to the repository
cohort.selection: entire checksum-pinned held-out source test split

limitations: This is a narrow binary pediatric domain-transfer test (normal versus pneumonia), not an adult multi-finding clinical validation.
The public acquisition view does not expose patient grouping, so bootstrap intervals are image-level rather than patient-clustered.
The pinned source convention is 0=NORMAL and 1=PNEUMONIA; its 234 normal and 390 pneumonia test labels are used as released.
The source label is used as released; no model threshold was selected or tuned on this test split.
The result evaluates the classifier component only, not the GPT-driven MedRAX agent or a clinical workflow.

Pneumonia.relation_note: Direct finding-name match to the held-out source binary label.

scope: tool-level external dataset evaluation; not a full MedRAX-agent or clinical evaluation
score_semantics: TorchXRayVision operating-point-normalized model score in [0, 1]; not a calibrated probability.
